refFieldPath.description: Reference field path that the details are for.

numFound.description:
Number of objs found with invalid references for the reference field path.  The {@link CheckReferencesSpec.limit} is ignored however
the {@link CheckReferencesSpec.filter} is not.  Therefore this number can be higher than would be indicated by the {@link messages}

messages.description:
Detailed messages indicating which the specific broken links found via the fetch with the {@link CheckReferencesSpec.limit} applied.  Since arry/mapp
fields contain references to multiple objs, the number of messages may exceed the value specified in @link CheckReferencesSpec.limit}.
